newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE says relaunched after-hours options trading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE says relaunched after-hours options trading.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Monday it had relaunched its electronic options trading system "APT Plus" last Thursday, October 3.
The system allows LIFFE members to trade German government bond options from their own offices and provides an after-hours electronic trading environment, LIFFE said.

There are curently 61 APT Plus qualified traders, representing 21 member firms, LIFFE said. On the first day of trading 23 traders participated in the new system. More than 1,800 Bund options were traded on the fist two days of trading.
APT Plus was orignially launched on January 26 with Bund options but was forced to close after 15 minutes because of technical problems.
